# Feature Requirements Quality Checklist: Run Powerups and Perks

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of gameplay,
authority, contract, recovery, and accessible interaction requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Progression and Economy Clarity

- [ ] CHK001 Are the initial XP, level, unspent points, perk levels, and life charges each defined unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the cumulative threshold formula consistent with every numerical boundary example and multi-level award scenario? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the ordering of Extra XP and Double Food multiplication explicit enough to yield one objective XP result at every perk level? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Luck, Extra XP, and held-life costs and caps specified for every current value, including after a life is consumed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the specification distinguish earned, spent, retained, and reset progression for restart versus life recovery? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-023, §FR-025]

## Powerup and Timing Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 Are spawn timing, maximum board count, chance boundaries, equal type odds, and eligible-cell rules all defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-014–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the meaning of “25% faster” quantified consistently with the normal pace calculation and 60 ms effective floor? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “five seconds” consistently defined as active-play time for activation, pause, refresh, expiration, and collision eligibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017–FR-021]
- [ ] CHK009 Are same-type refresh and different-type coexistence requirements explicit for all three powerups? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is Double Food consumption defined for food, ordinary movement, powerup collection, pause, Shield cancellation, life respawn, and restart? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §FR-023, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the near-full-board rule distinguish powerup displacement, replacement food, and the actual full-board win condition without contradiction? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014–FR-016, Edge Cases]

## Collision and Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Is defense precedence explicit when Shield and one or more life charges coexist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the retained, cleared, regenerated, and reset fields individually specified for Shield cancellation and life respawn? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-023–FR-024]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the safe-turn opportunity after a Shield cancellation defined strongly enough to avoid replaying the same colliding intent? [Clarity, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK015 Are both wall and self collision outcomes covered for no defense, Shield only, life only, and both defenses? [Scenario Coverage, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK016 Are respawn overlap and impossible-placement behaviors specified for snake, food, and board powerup? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-023–FR-024]

## Authority and Contract Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Is the division between authoritative pause/purchase/gameplay state and local shop visibility explicit and consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010–FR-012, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK018 Are all accepted and rejected purchase preconditions, exact costs, atomicity guarantees, and no-mutation outcomes documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the API addendum define exact request fields, success publication/revision behavior, and every failure code required by the spec? [Traceability, Contract §Purchase a perk]
- [ ] CHK020 Are snapshot requirements sufficiently relational to reject level/XP, cost/cap, occupancy, effect, and ready-state inconsistencies? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Snapshot validation relationships]
- [ ] CHK021 Is malformed WebSocket behavior defined without weakening the existing read-only connection or last-valid-state recovery? [Exception Flow, Contract §WebSocket event envelope]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the unchanged Hint data/tool boundary explicit in the feature requirements, plan, and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029–FR-030]

## Interaction and Acceptance Quality

- [ ] CHK023 Are S, SHOP, P, Space, pause, Resume, restart, and non-paused-snapshot behaviors defined without conflicting resume paths? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are numeric alternatives, decorative-cube semantics, keyboard/touch access, purchase feedback, and focus-safe controls specified for non-visual and touch users? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-011–FR-013, Research §Decision 9]
- [ ] CHK025 Can each success criterion be objectively traced to at least one frozen quickstart scenario without relying on random manual observation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-008, Quickstart §Frozen acceptance scenarios]
- [ ] CHK026 Are responsive and reduced-motion presentation requirements bounded enough for reviewer evaluation without introducing a visual redesign? [Scope, Quickstart §Manual presentation matrix]
- [ ] CHK027 Are all explicit exclusions consistent across the feature spec, constitution, and implementation plan? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Depth: standard pre-implementation reviewer gate.
- Focus: gameplay/state semantics plus API/snapshot/UX boundaries, the two highest-risk clusters.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant resources where useful.
